name: Fear of Losing
source:
Fear of Losing is a game that tells secrets and gives you an opportunity to think about your surroundings... Arseny is an ordinary guy, the hero of the game. But will you be able to understand his story and make the right choices?... Let's see...

In the game, the story of a forgotten love will await you... Or not such a forgotten one?...

[Translated from [url=https://noveldevel.itch.io/fear-of-losing]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Fear of Losing》是一款讲述秘密并让你有机会思考周围环境的游戏……阿尔森尼是一个普通人，是游戏的英雄。但你能理解他的故事并做出正确的选择吗？…让我们看看…

在游戏中，一段被遗忘的爱情的故事正在等待着你……或者不是这样一个被遗忘的爱情？……

[译自[url=https://noveldevel.itch.io/fear-of-losing]itch.io[/url]]
